description: Search the AI Training Data Broker blog by topic, for example "what is my company data worth", "is it legal", "exclusive license", "RL data". Returns matching articles with a one-line summary and a link to the full article. Limitation: plain word matching in English, at most 10 results.

audience.description: seller: companies selling or licensing their data. buyer: AI labs and model teams sourcing data. deid: de-identifying data to meet privacy laws (HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR). Leave out for all.
